summary: Completed E2E testing of Crystal Blue Water Solution water lab diagnostics and inquiry management flows. Fixed key frontend integration bug resolving undefined status updates.
action_items: Verify the status updates are fully persistent as demonstrated by Pytest & Playwright tests.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical issues. The layout and styles use a highly premium Swiss design aesthetic, perfect for luxury audience.
FastAPI + MongoDB is extremely fast, responsive and reliable.
seed_data_creation: Created testing entries: 'TEST_Alex Mercer' and 'TEST_E2E Analyst V2' during testing to verify persistence and update functions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All tests are passing. Both local port 3000 and external URL clarity-labs-3.preview.emergentagent.com are fully synced and verified.
rca of the issue: Integration bug fixed: The backend serializes model MongoDB ID alias as '_id', while the frontend expected 'inq.id'. When dispatching update requests, the frontend passed 'undefined' as the ID resulting in 400 Bad Request. Fixed this in App.js by reading 'item.id || item._id' to resolve it transparently and correctly.
